R2: keyed by the statement's SHA-256, the project, the case identity and the acknowledger, a repeat answering existed; on an unsigned document it re-authors only that document's list, so its hash moves

R2: matched by the identity it was given at, or by the draft named at publication, never by the statement's bytes; every list states acknowledged (zero included), withholds and counts the publisher's and the writer's own rows, withholds and counts every participant row when the writer is undetermined, and counts, never names, readings bindable to no case; nothing about an acknowledgement refuses publication
R2: a list names at most STATEMENT_ACK_MAX (500) rows and says so (truncated); one under the bound is not truncated

R2: an acknowledgement answers the edition the draft's identity states — null for a draft whose case publication derives (no case named, no new case asked), stated on both doors and never dropped; 1 for a new case's draft; the named case's next for a named one — while the row stays keyed at the identity it was given at

R3: statement_by is the member whose write made the statement's current bytes — the named draft's stamp; else a draft of the project holding that sentence; else the publisher, named as both; drafts disagreeing, or a draft from before the stamp, make it null, stated undetermined; it answers where the name came from and writes nothing

R9: carryOutcome's refusals, in order, each writing nothing: MACHINE_CANNOT_CARRY_OUTCOME; NO_SUCH_CASE, one answer for a case with no ratified edition and one whose project the member does not see; CARRY_NOT_A_PARTICIPANT; BAD_CARRIED_OUTCOME naming the field

R9: withdrawCarriedOutcome withdraws a pending outcome with the member's reason; refusals in order, each writing nothing: MACHINE_CANNOT_CARRY_OUTCOME, NO_SUCH_CARRIED_OUTCOME (absent or unseen alike), CARRIED_OUTCOME_SETTLED (withdrawn already), CARRY_NO_REASON
R9: carriedOutcomesOf is fenced as R1's member door: a joined participant of the case's project reads it; every other caller, an unknown case included, receives R1's dead answer, byte-identical

R9: pendingOutcomes answers the case's pending outcomes in the order carried, each {outcome, kind, text, cites, on, carried_by, carried_at}, asking no viewer and writing nothing; a withdrawn one is not pending

R9 (controls): a replaced preparation leaves an outcome pending, and carries it again; once a ratified edition's signed document holds it, it is carried (with that edition), settled, and pending no longer; the edition after it carries only what no ratified edition carries
